How it works

One control point for risky agent actions.

01

Agent requests review

Send the proposed action, context, risk type, and run ID.

02

Human decides

Approve, reject, edit, instruct the agent, or take over.

03

Workflow continues

Forsig returns structured data and an audit trail.

Developer API

Add a checkpoint where your agent needs judgment.

const decision = await forsig.intervene({
  agent: "refund-agent",
  risk: "refund_over_limit",
  proposedAction: "Issue $500 refund",
  waitForDecision: true
});
